messages:
maya: Quick sync 9 — finalize landing copy for Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Need hero variants, webinar hooks, benchmark blurbs, and inbound lead routing. Can we ship copy today?

devon: I sketched three hero lines: 1) Ship LLM features that hit predictable latency and cost. 2) Same API. Any scale. Your data, your controls. 3) From dev to production: inference that stays fast and cheap.

sam: Prefer #2 for Private, #1 for Hosted, #3 for Dedicated. Will check claims vs product.

lee: Proposed CTAs: Hosted: "Try Hosted API  free credits"; Dedicated: "Reserve Dedicated capacity"; Private: "Talk to sales for VPC / on-prem". Visual notes: padlock for Private; spinner/fast results for Hosted.

devon: Webinar hooks: Tech demo: "Live: how we shave ~40% token cost across workloads  demo + perf deep-dive". Customer workshop: "Migrating to Dedicated: maintaining latency SLOs".

sam: Benchmark blurb draft: "Benchmarked on popular open models: p95 < 300ms; 30-45% unit cost reduction with batching + KV cache vs naive serving."

ops-bot: benchmark-note: internal lab, g4dn-equivalent, 10k requests, p95 reported. Methodology should be footnoted.

nilesh: Routing asks: Hosted leads -> marketing nurture; Dedicated & Private -> AE queue (high-touch). Add hidden fields: mode_interest and benchmark_event_rsvp.

maya: Routing mapping: mode_interest=hosted -> lead_queue=mar_nurture; mode_interest=dedicated -> lead_queue=ae_queue_high; mode_interest=private -> lead_queue=ae_queue_high; benchmark_event_rsvp=true -> tag=benchmark_rsvp.

devon: Form subhead microcopy: Hosted: "Start with free credits  no infra changes." Dedicated: "Capacity guarantees & isolation for production." Private: "VPC & on-prem options for regulated data."

lee: Add a compact comparison block: rows: Performance (latency), Cost (per-token), Compliance — one-line bullets each.

sam: Place webinar CTA near Hosted hero (trial signups) and near Dedicated/Private blocks (AE invites). A/B test: 'Join live demo' vs 'Watch benchmark replay'.

nilesh: Confirmed with ops: hidden fields are mode_interest & benchmark_event_rsvp; HubSpot mapping set; I'll run a test submit this afternoon.

sam: Footnote copy: 'Internal lab, 10k requests, g4dn-equivalent hardware; results vary by model, prompt, and infra.'

maya: I'll consolidate and open a web PR once dev assets (copy + figma frames) are ready. Ops-bot: add UTM params utm_source=site, utm_campaign=tri-mode-launch. Thanks team  meeting at 4pm if needed.'
